name: McCann Fabrication
old_description: McCann Fabrication is a full-service custom metal fabricator that provides a comprehensive range of quality crafted metal products and equipment. Since 1983, we’ve sustained a continuum of growth based on the practice of total quality management and one guiding principal: putting our integrity into action. We use only raw materials of the finest quality, and test all our products to ensure optimal safety and performance. Our impressive range of capabilities includes cutting, bending, welding, machining, waterjet cutting, and finishing, as well as handling and logistics.
about:
McCann Fabrication operates from New Gloucester, Maine, where brothers Bill and Dick McCann founded the company in 1983. The business remains family-owned and operated, with three generations of the McCann family currently working on site and nearly three-quarters of the workforce having tenure of 15 years or more.

The shop delivers full-service custom metal fabrication across a 26,400-square-foot facility staffed by 30-plus employees running three shifts, seven days a week. Core processes include cutting, bending, welding, machining, 5-axis waterjet cutting, shearing, forming, plasma cutting, plate rolling, punching, band sawing, and finishing, supported by handling and logistics. Key equipment includes Cincinnati hydraulic press brakes (350- and 175-ton), a PaR 5-axis waterjet system with a 73-by-121-inch work envelope, Cincinnati shears, a Vicon CNC plasma cutter, a JetLine seam welder, Hyd-Mech band saws, a Roundo plate roll, and a Geka ironworker.

McCann serves customers in commercial construction, food processing, manufacturing, ornamental metalwork, pharmaceutical, power generation, public works, pulp and paper, and wastewater treatment, among other sectors.

The company emphasizes personalized service enabled by its family ownership, collaborative partnerships with engineering firms and coating houses, and a continuous investment in technology such as 3D CAD (Inventor 2020) and annual equipment upgrades to meet demanding deadlines.
